name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door and pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) requires the box and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) puts opening the door before it; together they force both events in the task's implied order.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u3
(u2, target_picked_up) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> -10
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> 1
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u3) -> 12
(u2, target_picked_up, u3) -> 11
